item.title: New sign installed at Seattle's Pike Place Market
item.description: Pike Place Market has installed its first new sign in nearly 100 years.

item.title: 'Seattle News Weekly': Potential buyers for Seahawks
item.description: On this episode of the "Seattle News Weekly" podcast, FOX 13 Seattle Anchors Bill Wixey and Matthew Smith discuss the week's biggest stories in Seattle.

item.title: 23-year-old arrested for knife attack in Arlington, WA
item.description: Police say the knife attack at a gas station in Arlington appears to have been done at random.

item.title: Video shows arrest of WA car prowl suspect who tried to flee
item.description: A 38-year-old man accused of car prowls across multiple Eastside cities was arrested after deputies shattered his car window during a failed escape attempt.

item.title: Chilly weather in Seattle with a rainier weekend
item.description: Wet weather increases by daybreak Saturday with a brief rain-snow mix possible in the lowlands Saturday morning, mainly across the South Sound and southwestern interior.

item.title: 'Soft Gold': The maritime fur trade that wiped out Washington’s sea otters
item.description: Sea otters were hunted to extinction in Washington by 1910, but have since returned, boosting coastal ecosystems and inspiring conservation efforts.

item.title: ‘Breath of relief,’ WA business owner says on SCOTUS ruling on Trump tariffs
item.description: Washington small business owners say they are relieved to have SCOTUS rule against the Trump tariffs. they tell us about living with the economic fallout for months.

item.title: New docs reveal red flags in WA daycare child molestation case
item.description: Newly obtained police documents are revealing disturbing new details in a child molestation investigation at a Lake Stevens childcare center, including allegations involving multiple toddlers.

item.title: WA governor proposes revenue from millionaire tax go to sales tax holidays
item.description: Governor Bob Ferguson says a portion of the revenue raised by the "millionaires tax" should fund two annual sales tax holidays.

item.title: Copper wire theft disrupts 1 Line service between Federal Way, Angle Lake
item.description: Light rail service was restored for the 1 Line after a copper wire theft disrupted service between Angle Lake and Federal Way Thursday night into Friday morning.
